en.title: Injection Molding Manufacturing
en.summary: Process follow-up and testing for switchboard parts manufacturing.
en.challenge: An injection-molded component required coordinated product geometry, mold design, process simulation, machining, molding, and quality follow-up.
contribution: Created product and tooling geometry in SolidWorks.
Used Moldex3D to review fill behavior and process risks before manufacturing.
Supported CNC/tooling work, molding trials, inspection, and corrective iteration.
technical: CAD defines the part, mold, and manufacturing interfaces.
Moldex3D simulates filling and highlights likely process or design issues.
CNC tooling, injection trials, and inspection close the loop with physical evidence.

architecture.label: Design
architecture.detail: Requirements become part geometry and mold/tooling concepts.

architecture.label: Simulation
architecture.detail: Mold-flow analysis evaluates filling, pressure, cooling, and defect risk.

architecture.label: Manufacture
architecture.detail: CNC and tooling preparation enable injection-molding trials.

architecture.label: Quality loop
architecture.detail: Inspection and test results drive revisions to design or process settings.

outcomes: Worked across the complete design-to-manufacturing lifecycle.
Used simulation to inform physical process decisions before and during trials.
Developed practical experience coordinating CAD, tooling, production, and quality.

zh.title: 射出成型製造
zh.summary: 跟進配電盤零件的射出成型流程與測試。
zh.role: 機械設計與製造工程師
zh.challenge: 射出成型零件需要協調產品幾何、模具設計、製程模擬、加工、成型與品質追蹤。
contribution: 使用 SolidWorks 建立產品與模具幾何。
在製造前使用 Moldex3D 檢視充填行為與製程風險。
支援 CNC 與模具作業、射出試模、檢驗及修正迭代。
technical: CAD 定義零件、模具與製造介面。
Moldex3D 模擬充填，並指出潛在製程或設計問題。
CNC 模具加工、射出試模與檢驗以實體證據完成閉環驗證。

architecture.label: 設計
architecture.detail: 將需求轉換為零件幾何與模具概念。

architecture.label: 模擬
architecture.detail: 模流分析評估充填、壓力、冷卻與缺陷風險。

architecture.label: 製造
architecture.detail: CNC 與模具準備支援射出成型試模。

architecture.label: 品質迴圈
architecture.detail: 檢驗與測試結果回饋至設計或製程參數修正。

outcomes: 參與完整的設計至製造生命週期。
在試模前與試模期間，以模擬支援實際製程決策。
累積協調 CAD、模具、量產與品質工作的實務經驗。
